from dep_inventory_warning w inner join fd_department d on d.id = w.department_id inner join fd_material m on m.id = w.material_id left join fd_unit u on u.unit_id = m.unit_id left join fd_factory ff on ff.factory_id = m.factory_id inner join ( select s.tenant_id, s.department_id, s.material_id, sum(ifnull(s.qty, 0)) as total_qty, avg(s.unit_price) as avg_unit_price from stk_dep_inventory s left join fd_material mm on mm.id = s.material_id where (s.del_flag = 0 or s.del_flag is null) and ifnull(s.qty, 0) > 0 and (mm.id is null or ((mm.del_flag is null or mm.del_flag != 1) and (mm.is_use is null or mm.is_use = '' or mm.is_use != '2')))
and (s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) group by s.tenant_id, s.department_id, s.material_id ) agg on agg.tenant_id = w.tenant_id and agg.department_id = w.department_id and agg.material_id = w.material_id where (w.del_flag = 0 or w.del_flag is null) and (d.del_flag = 0 or d.del_flag is null) and (m.del_flag is null or m.del_flag != 1) and ( (w.min_qty_warning is not null and ifnull(agg.total_qty, 0) < w.min_qty_warning) or (w.max_qty_warning is not null and w.max_qty_warning > 0 and ifnull(agg.total_qty, 0) > w.max_qty_warning) )
and (w.tenant_id = #{tenantId})

select ifnull(d.name, '') as departmentName, ifnull(m.code, '') as materialCode, ifnull(m.name, '') as materialName, ifnull(m.speci, '') as materialSpeci, ifnull(u.unit_name, '') as unitName, ifnull(agg.avg_unit_price, 0) as unitPrice, ifnull(agg.total_qty, 0) as qty, w.min_qty_warning as minQtyWarning, w.max_qty_warning as maxQtyWarning, ifnull(ff.factory_name, '') as factoryName
order by ifnull(d.name, ''), ifnull(m.name, ''), ifnull(m.code, '') limit 500
